alternateExpression: totalDebits is equal to totalCredits for every constructed journal entry
the predicted expense account must be a member of the fixed chart of accounts; if it is not, the entry is rejected rather than guessed
amount must be strictly greater than zero
if paid is true, then the credit account is Cash/Bank; if paid is false, then the credit account is Accounts Payable
the debit account is always the predicted expense account, never a mechanical account (Cash/Bank or Accounts Payable)
